message: `aria-relevant="additions text"` on the part sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part with its `status` and the `aria-relevant="additions text"` the role implies, written. It costs nothing measured and is refused by the rule, as a written `aria-live` is: Firefox 158 exposes no relevance for the `status` alone and `container-relevant` for the written one, Chromium 153 the same value either way (measured on 2026-10-27), and a reading that allowed the role's own value would have to say which spellings are it (`ADDITIONS TEXT` goes on as written in both).
